tasks.title: Write Dunford positioning: alternatives, unique attributes, value, best-fit customer, category
tasks.why: Every channel's copy derives from this; skipping it produces hype titles that HN/Reddit punish.

tasks.title: Fix success_metric, success_target and kill_threshold (with numbers) in the manifest
tasks.why: Decide what 'worked' means before launch-day dopamine. Rank is vanity; activation and revenue are not.

tasks.title: Get 3+ paid pre-orders/deposits or signed LOIs from the target audience at the planned price
tasks.why: Waitlists prove interest, not willingness to pay. Revenue before launch is the only real validation.

tasks.title: Recruit 5-10 beta users from the target audience; onboard them personally
tasks.why: Superhuman pattern: onboarding is research. Finds the top friction before strangers do.

tasks.title: Collect 3-5 named testimonials (photo, role, concrete outcome) from beta users; add to landing + pricing
tasks.why: Cold launch traffic has no reason to trust you; outcome-specific quotes lift signup and checkout conversion.

tasks.title: Privacy policy, terms, refund policy live; cookie consent if non-essential tracking; VAT via merchant of record (Paddle/Lemon Squeezy) or Stripe Tax
tasks.why: UK GDPR/PECR and EU VAT apply from the first EU/UK sale or email. Not legal advice; check your jurisdiction.

tasks.title: Stranger test: someone unaided reaches first value in <5 min, no signup wall before value where possible
tasks.why: PostHog launched only once strangers could self-serve; Show HN rejects signup-gated products.

tasks.title: Instrument signup, activation event and payment; UTM per channel; verify events fire
tasks.why: Without per-channel attribution you cannot tell which channel to repeat next launch.

tasks.title: Pricing page live; checkout works end to end (real card, then refund)
tasks.why: Levels: charge from day one. Launch traffic that can't pay is wasted traffic.

tasks.title: Founding-member offer (e.g. 30% off annual) with a REAL deadline at T+7; shown on pricing, PH, HN, email
tasks.why: Converts the ~72h spike into revenue; annual = upfront cash + lower churn. Never fake the deadline.

tasks.title: Add an invite/share prompt right after the activation moment (2 taps, good OG preview, two-sided reward if fits)
tasks.why: Turns each activated signup into a channel. Track invites sent/accepted per activated user.

tasks.title: Record 30-60s demo video/GIF showing the core outcome, plus 3-5 screenshots
tasks.why: Reused across PH gallery, HN first comment, X, Reddit, email. One asset, every channel.

tasks.title: 3-email drip keyed to the activation event: welcome+first step (0h), nudge if not activated (24h), use case+offer (72h)
tasks.why: Most launch signups never activate; personal-followup can't scale past ~50 people.

tasks.title: Smoke-test production under a burst (signup, core flow, payment); error alerting on
tasks.why: A spike that hits a broken signup is unrecoverable; it decays in ~72h.

tasks.title: Clear the calendar for 12+ hours on T0 to reply to every comment
tasks.why: The comment thread IS the launch on PH and HN; sustained engagement beats one spike.

tasks.title: Reply to every comment, DM and email within the hour, all day
Ship fixes for the top 3 complaints from launch feedback; reply in-thread when fixed
Personally email signups who didn't activate (or the top 50); ask what blocked them
Email activated free users a direct upgrade offer referencing the launch-offer deadline
Fill the manifest [results] table: signups, activated, paying, mrr, top_channel
Ask activated/paying users for a review (PH, G2/Capterra or store) and a reusable quote
tasks.why: Social proof banked now makes the next launch convert better.

tasks.title: Retro: which channel produced paying users? Edit tasks.toml with the lessons
tasks.why: Supabase runs a retro after every launch week. This is how the engine compounds across projects.

tasks.title: Publish launch post-mortem + 3 '<competitor> alternative' / comparison pages; link from directory listings
tasks.why: Launch traffic decays to zero; search traffic compounds. 'X alternative' intent converts (Cal.com).

tasks.title: T+30 verdict: update [results], compare to success_target / kill_threshold: double down, pivot or kill
If double down: schedule next launch (v2/integration/platform) + new manifest. If kill: archive manifest, move hours to top-revenue project
tasks.why: Tally 2.0 relaunch: +91% weekly signups. But relaunching a killed product wastes the slot.

tasks.title: Run Sean Ellis survey on beta users ('very disappointed' %); record the score
tasks.why: Superhuman held its gate until ~40% very disappointed. Below that, a launch amplifies a leaky product.

tasks.title: Waitlist page live: one-line positioning, email capture with explicit consent text + privacy link, double opt-in
tasks.why: Most dependable launch-day asset (Tally's 500-1,500 community seeded its PH #1). Consent makes it legally sendable.

tasks.title: Send a build update to the waitlist every 1-2 weeks (progress, screenshot, one question)
Draft launch email: what it does, link to YOUR site (UTM), one ask (try it). Unsubscribe link. Never 'please upvote'
tasks.why: Sending a burst of list members straight to the PH/HN page looks like a vote ring.

tasks.title: Send launch email to opted-in subscribers only
Email launch signups 'you asked, we shipped': top-3 fixes + last-day offer reminder
Start build-in-public posts 3x/week: progress, numbers, failures
tasks.why: X only works on an existing audience (Levels: >50% of Photo AI traffic from X). 30 days is too short to build one.

tasks.title: DM 20-50 genuine supporters: 'launching <date>, would love your feedback' with a link to your site. No vote asks
Post launch thread: problem, demo video, link, story
Post launch numbers transparently (traffic, signups, revenue, what failed)
Use your PH account genuinely (comment, upvote others) so it's established, not new
tasks.why: Ranking weights engagement from established accounts; new-account voting is discounted/penalised.

tasks.title: Create PH 'coming soon' page and link it from the waitlist
PH listing ready: tagline <60 chars, gallery (demo first), maker first comment drafted
Launch 12:01am PT (Tue-Thu); post maker comment; share 'we're live' (never 'upvote me')
tasks.why: Coordinated voting is detected and penalised. Featured rate fell sharply post-2024.

tasks.title: Confirm Show HN eligibility: people can try it now, no signup wall / landing page only
tasks.why: showhn.html rules. Gated products get flagged off-topic.

tasks.title: Draft first comment: backstory, how it's built, what feedback you want
Post 'Show HN: <Name> – <plain description>' Tue-Thu US morning; no hype, no vote asks, don't share the HN link
tasks.why: Separate day from PH. First 60-90 min decide the front page. Alternative: an opinionated essay (Plausible).

tasks.title: Pick 3-5 subs where users live; read each sub's rules; contribute genuine comments for 4+ weeks
tasks.why: Sub rules override 90/10; some cap promotion at 1/week. No history = removal or shadowban.

tasks.title: Post max 1-2 subs/day, each a distinct native-format post (no cross-post spam), disclose you're the maker
Founder story post (personal, not company page); link in first comment
Post launch write-up with real numbers on Indie Hackers
tasks.why: Low traffic but long-tail search + newsletter pickup (Tally, Plausible).

tasks.title: Submit to BetaList (free queue is weeks long; submit early)
One-afternoon batch: submit to 20-30 relevant directories / alternative-to sites
tasks.why: Mostly SEO/backlinks, not users. Timebox it.

tasks.title: Google Play closed test with the required opted-in testers for the required consecutive days; production access approved
tasks.why: New personal Play accounts must pass a closed test before production (was 12 testers x 14 days; verify current rule).

tasks.title: Enable Google Play pre-registration
Play listing final: screenshots, feature graphic, preview video, short/long description keywords, data safety form
Set up iOS pre-order (up to 180 days ahead)
Submit Apple 'Promote your app' featuring request (2+ weeks ahead)
App Store listing final: screenshots, preview video, keywords, review approved
Only after a 'double down' verdict: model LTD support load and revenue split from the current contract
tasks.why: LTD buyers are price-sensitive and support-heavy; AppSumo revenue reportedly falling 2024-25.

tasks.title: Etsy SEO: title <=140 chars front-loading buyer search terms, all 13 tags used (<=20 chars, multi-word), attributes filled
tasks.why: Etsy search is the launch channel for digital products; empty tags and attributes are lost impressions.

tasks.title: 8-10 listing images (2000px), image 1 readable as a thumbnail; add a 5-15s listing video
Buyer test: download the delivered files, open in Excel, Google Sheets and Numbers on PC and phone; run verify.py
tasks.why: One 'file doesn't work' review at launch tanks conversion for months.

tasks.title: Mirror the listing on Payhip (own customer emails, lower fees); link it from your bio and emails
tasks.why: Etsy owns the customer; Payhip lets you build the list the next launch needs.

tasks.title: Publish at the launch price; pin the hero image to Pinterest with the listing link
Thank every buyer in a message and ask for an honest review. Never offer an incentive (Etsy policy)
tasks.why: Early reviews drive Etsy ranking; incentivised reviews breach Etsy's policy.

tasks.title: Etsy Ads test: small daily budget for 14 days; keep only listings whose ads return more than they cost
Move from launch price to full price (after 30 days or 20 reviews, as the listing promises)
tasks.why: The launch price must really end, or it's a fake discount (DMCC Act 2024 / CMA pricing guidance).

tasks.title: Schedule the category's seasonal push (UK tax: early January before the 31 Jan Self Assessment deadline; April tax year)
Pick ONE implementation of this tool; archive the duplicate branches with a note
tasks.why: Duplicate builds split effort and data; nothing gets used daily.

tasks.title: Write the one decision this tool must improve, and its usage metric (e.g. opened 5 of 7 days)
Deploy behind owner-only auth; check that a logged-out browser cannot see it
Install as an app on Windows (Edge/Chrome) and Android (Chrome); confirm it opens offline
Test backup and restore: export on PC, import on phone, data matches
Use it in the daily review for 7 days in a row
Verdict against the usage metric: keep, merge into another tool, or delete
